package.name: behavior_planner_cpp
package.description: Strict-priority FSM behavior planner for the BFMC autonomy stack. Consumes /vehicle/state, /perception/tracked_objects, /perception/lane_geometry, /planning/global_path, /fusion/imu_confidence. Emits /planning/behavior_state (current maneuver name) and /planning/target_speed plus six debug topics. LifecycleNode for symmetry with the existing Python planner; publish topics match the Python contract so swap-in is a launch-file edit.
